Data Request #:: Per Legislative request this report should include
DRT0187760: Patient Count, Visits, Procedures performed, Amount Paid
By Location and county of all providers ( Billing and Rendering)

Data Request #:: To be able to display the Information as accurate as possible the report is divided into multiple TABs as described below

DRT0187760: All the professional Providers ( CMS 1500 And Dental , MCT, LME-MCO) are Grouped by Payer with regular visits to the doctors and have procedures performed at the provider location

Institutional Claims like Outpatient, Home Health ,Outpatient Crossover  are Grouped together by Payer with regular Visits, with Revenue codes instead of Procedure codes as a group of services are performed

Institutional Claims Like (Hospice/Nursing Home/Mental Health/Inpatient -Inpatient Crossover Non Acute care) the visits are calculated in days or number of days the patient stayed at the facility grouped by Payer
Institutional Claims like ( Acute Care  - Inpatient and Inpatient Crossover the visits calculation is actually based on number of Stays with the DRG counts by Payer
The Drug claims cannot be counted as Visits and so Scrips have been included for all payers

Data Request #:: The Billing address in some cases can be blank or Unknown because the claim comes in without a location or may not have a county entered
The Billing county code/Name may not be found for any Unknown location when a claim comes in without location Details or missing county code
The Billing county code/Name  for Pharmacy claims are not available in the system and so only the Primary address of the billing provider is populated
The rendering provider is replaced with the Billing Provider information for all UB 04 Claims except for - Outpatient and Medicare Part B Outpatient Crossover Claims
For any Out patient State Hospital Claims the Provider Attending the Patient has been included as the Rendering Provider
For certain CMS 1500 Claims listed in bold below, the Rendering Provider information is not included because they may or may not have a rendering provider in most cases
LEAs/Home Infusion /Therapy Services/Portable X-rays/Laboratory X ray/DME/Optical/Ambulance
The Rendering provider information is not available for any Pharmacy claims
After all the above replacement whenever the Rendering provider information is missing it is replaced by the Billing Provider information
The Rendering Provider County Code/ Name and Rendering Provider Taxonomy Code is also replaced with the Billing Provider Information based on the above Criteria
The Rendering Provider Service facility address is not always submitted
The CSRA has a Certain Algorithm to calculate the Rendering provider Location Code.
For the claims when the Rendering Provider information is pulled from the claim ( like the Professional Claim for example), the location code is based on the CSRA Algorithm
Professional Claims- The Visits for CMS 1500 are calculated based on the member visits by Service dates at available location Information
Institutional Claims The Visit are some times based on length of stay or number of Days stayed at the facility
Pharmacy Claims- The Visits for Pharmacy are really Scrips and are based on Member Visit to Pharmacy by Service date
Details on Visit calculation is available on each tab with more specifics
The Number of Procedures performed are  count of Procedure code or revenue code depending on the claim type
For Pharmacy claims there are no Procedures Performed and so the Claim count is provided to get an Idea of Drug counts
